data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 静夜床榻的白棉吊带私语
data.description: 深夜弦神岛的公寓卧室内，台灯的光芒昏暗而温暖。雪菜仅着一件纯白细吊带纯棉睡裙坐在床头，乌黑的长发松散垂在光滑的背脊与胸前。她怀中抱着棉枕，白皙的脚踝在被单边缘微露。褐眸水光盈盈，面对近在咫尺的目光，少女脸颊泛着滚烫的红晕，轻启温软朱唇吐露着心底最真实的爱恋。
data.action: sitting on bed in pure white cotton camisole, hugging pillow to chest, bare shoulders and collarbone exposed, blushing deeply, brown eyes full of tender confession
data.location: quiet dim apartment bedroom illuminated by soft bedside table lamp
data.lighting: warm gentle ambient bedside lamp casting cozy intimate shadows
data.mood: pure unvarnished first love, delicate trembling devotion
data.promptProse: Sitting on her bed in a simple white cotton camisole, Himeragi Yukina hugs a pillow to her chest. Her long black hair cascades over bare shoulders as her face burns with an earnest, heartfelt confession under warm lamplight.
data.animaCaption: Sitting on her bed in a white cotton camisole and hugging a pillow to her chest, she blushes deeply under the warm lamplight.
